# Sponsor Ready

> Free, no-signup checklist that scores a public GitHub repo against the signals that correlate with attracting GitHub Sponsors, and tells you exactly what to fix first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sponsor-ready/)
- [The GitHub Sponsors readiness checklist: 10 signals, ranked by weight](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sponsor-ready/github-sponsors-readiness-checklist.html)
- [Sponsor Ready vs. GitHub's Community Standards](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sponsor-ready/vs-github-community-standards.html)
